items.briefing:
A Victorian woman recently lost AUD $13,000 after receiving a convincing scam phone call impersonating her bank — a reminder that fraudsters are increasingly sophisticated and persistent. Separately, research highlights that Australian organisations are largely unprepared for AI-powered cyber attacks, which are becoming more targeted and harder to detect. These two issues are connected: criminals are using AI to make scam calls, emails, and messages more believable than ever before.

To protect yourself and your colleagues, **never act on unsolicited calls or messages claiming to be from your bank or IT team** — hang up and call the organisation back using a number from their official website.

featured.title: AIBUILD launches AI verifier to fight scam messages
featured.summary: Rising scam losses in Australia are pushing businesses to verify texts, images and voice notes before paying or acting on urgent requests.
